from pocket_coffea.analysis_tools import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak

class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor."""
    
    def object_preselection(self, data):
        """Build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4."""
        muons = data.Muon
        muon_mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        data["MuonGood"] = muons[muon_mask]
        return data
    
    def object_counting(self, data):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event."""
        data["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(data.MuonGood)
        return data
